name: mask-sensitive-columns
description: Defense-in-depth on top of pattern-based PII redaction: mask classically sensitive columns from every non-admin caller, everywhere. Masked columns are dropped from query results and the masking is disclosed in result lineage.

name: block-agents-from-source
description: Keep MCP agents out of one source entirely (both data and schema). Replace resource_id with the datasource id to protect. The mcp-stdio subject is the identity every MCP tool call runs as.

name: allow-primary-read-all
description: For hardened deployments running EIYE_ABAC_DEFAULT_DENY=true: grants the primary API key baseline read and schema access to every source. Without an allow policy, default-deny blocks all non-admin access.

name: allow-agents-approved-source
description: For default-deny deployments: admit MCP agents to one explicitly approved source only. Replace resource_id with the datasource id to expose. Pair with allow-primary-read-all or scope subjects as needed.
